comparison.objective: Seat a strain-wave flexspline in a joint housing until its teeth mesh, versus tune a mounted damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Axially align, press, and rotate a precision toothed insert; the candidate performs tool-mediated unlocking, collar adjustment, relocking, and repeated impact tests.
comparison.success_condition: Specified phase, lateral offset, tilt, seating gap, release, and stillness; no force-bounded carriage-stop outcome.
comparison.reason: Both include fine rotation and alignment, but tooth meshing/insertion is meaningfully different from closed-loop damper tuning.
